label.purpose: Tabs, fields, states, and compact controls.

shadows.name: fader-thumb
shadows.purpose: Small tactile lift for the draggable mixer thumb.

shadows.name: transient-overlay
shadows.purpose: Separation for dialogs and popovers only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committed action; baby blue is intentionally scarce.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; height:36px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:var(--accent-brand); padding:0 16px; color:#07151c; font:600 10.5px/1.35 var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--accent-brand); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.45; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default utility action for routine desktop work.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; height:36px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:4px; background:var(--surface-interactive); padding:0 16px; color:var(--text-primary); font:600 10.5px/1.35 var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--border-strong); background:var(--surface-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 72%, transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:var(--surface-1); }

components.name: Preset Select
components.description: A compact graphite field for device and preset selection.
components.css: .ds-select { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(172px,238px); align-items:center; gap:8px; color:var(--text-description); font:600 10.5px/1.35 var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-select select { height:34px; min-width:0; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:4px; background:var(--surface-interactive); padding:0 10px; color:var(--text-primary); font:600 11px/1.35 var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-select select:hover { border-color:var(--border-strong); background:var(--surface-hover); } .ds-select select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 45%, transparent); outline-offset:1px; } .ds-select select:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Audio Path Tabs
components.description: The quiet text rail that moves between Mixer, Game, Chat, Media, and Microphone.
components.html: <nav class="ds-audio-tabs" aria-label="Audio workspace"><button class="ds-audio-tab">Mixer</button><button class="ds-audio-tab ds-audio-tab-active" aria-current="page">Game</button><button class="ds-audio-tab">Chat</button><button class="ds-audio-tab">Media</button><button class="ds-audio-tab">Microphone</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-audio-tabs { display:flex; height:54px; align-items:stretch; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--background) 96%, var(--surface-1)); padding:0 20px; } .ds-audio-tab { position:relative; min-width:92px; border:0; background:transparent; padding:0 18px; color:var(--text-description); font:620 12.5px/1.35 var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:color 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-audio-tab:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-hover) 42%, transparent); color:var(--text-secondary); } .ds-audio-tab-active { color:var(--text-primary); } .ds-audio-tab-active::after { position:absolute; right:18px; bottom:-1px; left:18px; height:2px; background:var(--accent-brand); content:''; } .ds-audio-tab:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 72%, transparent); }

components.name: Setting Toggle
components.description: A plain-language setting row with explicit text and switch state.
components.html:
Output safety

Prevents sudden clipping and excessive peaks.
components.css: .ds-setting { display:flex; min-height:68px; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:7px; background:var(--surface-2); padding:14px 16px; color:var(--text-primary); font-family:var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-setting h3 { margin:0; font-size:13px; font-weight:650; } .ds-setting p { max-width:58ch; margin:4px 0 0; color:var(--text-description); font-size:10.5px; line-height:1.45; } .ds-setting label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; } .ds-switch { position:relative; width:42px; height:24px; border:1px solid var(--accent-brand); border-radius:999px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-brand) 25%, transparent); cursor:pointer; } .ds-switch span { position:absolute; top:2px; right:2px; width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent-brand); } .ds-switch:hover { border-color:var(--accent-hover); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 72%, transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: EQ Band Selector
components.description: A semantic band rail whose selected state is structural as well as colorful.
components.css: .ds-eq-bands { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:2px; border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 70%, transparent); padding-bottom:8px; font-family:var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-eq-band { display:flex; min-height:34px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:5px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:var(--text-description); cursor:pointer; } .ds-eq-band > span { width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ds-band); } .ds-eq-band strong { color:var(--text-secondary); font-size:10.5px; } .ds-eq-band small { font-size:10.5px; } .ds-eq-band:hover { background:var(--surface-hover); } .ds-eq-band-selected { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-band) 13%, transparent); color:var(--ds-band); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-band) 35%, transparent); } .ds-eq-band-selected strong { color:var(--ds-band); } .ds-eq-band:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Processing Module
components.description: A generous outcome-first module placed below the primary instrument.
components.html:
Volume leveling

Normalization + compressor
On

Keeps quiet and loud moments closer together.
components.css: .ds-processing { min-height:146px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:7px; background:var(--surface-2); padding:14px 16px 16px; color:var(--text-primary); font-family:var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-processing header { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; } .ds-processing h3 { display:inline; margin:0; font-size:13px; font-weight:650; } .ds-processing small { margin-left:8px; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:9.5px; } .ds-processing header > span { font-size:11px; font-weight:600; } .ds-processing p { max-width:58ch; margin:4px 0 12px; color:var(--text-description); font-size:10.5px; line-height:1.45; } .ds-segments { display:flex; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:4px; } .ds-segments button { height:38px; flex:1; border:0; border-left:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--surface-1); color:var(--text-muted); font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600; } .ds-segments button:first-child { border-left:0; } .ds-segments button:hover { background:var(--surface-hover); color:var(--text-primary); } .ds-segments .ds-segment-active { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-brand) 12%, transparent); color:var(--accent-brand); } .ds-segments button:focus-visible { position:relative; outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Mixer Fader
components.description: A tactile channel-colored level control with an exact numeric readout.
components.html:
Game

87%
components.css: .ds-fader { width:150px; border-right:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--surface-1); padding:13px 14px; color:var(--text-primary); font-family:var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); } .ds-fader header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom:10px; } .ds-channel-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ds-channel); } .ds-fader h3 { margin:0; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:650; } .ds-fader-body { display:flex; height:218px; justify-content:center; padding-top:14px; } .ds-fader-track { position:relative; width:5px; height:100%; border-radius:2px; background:var(--border-strong); } .ds-fader-range { position:absolute; right:0; bottom:0; left:0; height:62%; border-radius:2px; background:var(--ds-channel); } .ds-fader-thumb { position:absolute; top:36%; left:50%; display:flex; width:17px; height:23px; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid #c7ced8; border-radius:3px; background:#f3f5f8; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 38%); cursor:ns-resize; } .ds-fader-thumb span { width:9px; height:2px; background:var(--ds-channel); } .ds-fader-thumb:hover { border-color:#ffffff; } .ds-fader-thumb:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-fader output { display:block; width:58px; margin:8px auto 0; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:4px; background:var(--border-strong); padding:5px 6px; font-size:11px; font-weight:620; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-align:center; }

narrative.overview:
Switchboard is an ink-black Windows control surface with the calm legibility of studio equipment. Graphite modules, fine steel dividers, crisp utility type, and sparse semantic color make complex hardware and audio state readable without turning the product into a generic dashboard or gaming spectacle.

The interface is continuous and operational. Users select a path, act on one prominent instrument, then follow the signal flow into large plain-language controls. Capability truth is part of the visual system: unavailable, disabled, pending, error, and selected states remain explicit and survive canonical state round trips.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous console composition with visible signal flow
Full-width audio instruments followed by generous processing modules
Ink, graphite, and steel surfaces with baby-blue interaction states
Stable semantic colors for channels and EQ bands
Tight utility typography, thin dividers, and restrained corners
No ornamental effects competing with live controls

rules.name: The Blue Is Interaction Rule
rules.body: Baby blue appears where the user can act or where a primary state is active; it never becomes ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Stable Channel Identity Rule
rules.body: Master is baby blue, Game is teal, Chat is blue, Media is violet, and Microphone is amber everywhere those channels appear.

rules.name: The Band Identity Rule
rules.body: Every EQ band keeps its assigned color, but no selected or enabled state may rely on color alone.

rules.name: The Utility Before Theater Rule
rules.body: Type is compact and direct; hierarchy comes from weight and contrast, never oversized headings or decorative typography.

rules.name: The Instrument Leads Rule
rules.body: Each audio path is led by one broad instrument; never compress the EQ into a side rail or place routine processing ahead of it.

rules.name: The Continuous Desk Rule
rules.body: Related controls share aligned rows and dividers. Surfaces mark real functional boundaries, not decorative card nesting.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces use tone and dividers; shadow is reserved for transient elevation or a draggable physical control.

dos: Do lead each Game, Chat, Media, and Microphone path with its full-width EQ.
Do keep routine controls, current state, recovery actions, signal chain, meters, faders, and unavailable reasons visible.
Do preserve stable channel and EQ-band colors while adding non-color state cues.
Do use switches, segmented choices, faders, sliders, and graphs for the values they are designed to control.
Do verify 1080 × 720, 1420 × 900, and 1920 × 1080 without horizontal overflow.
Do extend existing shared shadcn/Radix primitives and the canonical audio contracts.
donts: Don't return audio processing to a compressed side rail or hide routine work behind repeated disclosure.
Don't restyle Switchboard as a website, generic dashboard, gaming overlay, or component-library showcase.
Don't use gradients, glow, glassmorphism, neon, decorative blur, ambient visualizers, ornamental animation, or routine shadows.
Don't introduce card grids, nested cards, pill-shaped text containers, giant radii, or decorative icon boxes.
Don't fabricate controls, telemetry, search, hardware capability, audio routing, or capture state.
Don't expose low-level identifiers outside diagnostics or bypass Electron's canonical state ownership.
